peru.title: Flag of Peru
desc: - Three vertical stripes with red outer bands and a white centre stripe
- The civil flag omits the coat of arms, while the state flag displays it centred on the white
trivia:
- The two vertical red stripes represent bloodshed for independence; the white represents peace
- The coat of arms shows a condor, llama, and chinchilla — representing the fauna of Peru's three regions
- Peru's state flag is narrower than the civil flag, creating two slightly different designs
